description: This file defines types and functions for handling reasoning details, including consolidation, sanitization, and conversion between Anthropic and OpenAI message formats, with special handling for Gemini models.

methods.name: consolidateReasoningDetails
methods.description: Consolidates an array of reasoning details by grouping by index and type, filtering out corrupted encrypted blocks, concatenating text and summaries, and keeping only the last encrypted data per group.

methods.name: sanitizeGeminiMessages
methods.description: Sanitizes OpenAI messages for Gemini models by filtering reasoning details to only include entries matching tool call IDs, and removing mismatched tool calls and related messages.

methods.name: convertToOpenAiMessages
methods.description: Converts Anthropic messages into OpenAI chat format, handling reasoning details, tool use, and tool result messages, with options for ID normalization and merging tool result text.
